title: Expedition Literature
skills: identify characteristics of expedition and exploration narratives
analyze how setting and journey shape narrative development
examine perspective and purpose in travel and adventure writing
connect exploration narratives to historical and cultural contexts
alignment_note: Introduces expedition literature as a form centered on journeys, exploration, travel, and encounters with unfamiliar places or experiences. Supports analysis of setting, perspective, narrative purpose, cultural context, and the traditions of travel and adventure writing across high school English courses.
